observations: At NeMo-Speech.cpp SHA 4f9676226f667d14608487df744f375db87127f8, the official MagpieTTS conversion instructions explicitly download nvidia/magpie_tts_multilingual_357m with --revision v2602 before GGUF conversion.
The same NeMo-Speech.cpp TTS configuration examples point at magpie_tts_multilingual_357m.v2602.f16.gguf and expose native German tokenization (de).

NVIDIA's official MagpieTTS model card identifies v2607 as the latest release and v2602 as an older checkpoint. v2607 adds languages and changes release behavior, including removal of zero-shot voice-cloning and updated G2P/code-switching support.
The official MagpieTTS card reports German metrics separately for v2602 and v2607, so they are not interchangeable benchmark identities.

finding.native_cpp_reference: Use exact v2602 as the documented NeMo-Speech.cpp native GGUF reference until v2607 conversion+load is independently demonstrated at exact identity.
finding.latest_model_challenger: Treat exact v2607 as a distinct latest-model challenger. Do not silently inherit NeMo-Speech.cpp native compatibility or runtime metrics from v2602.
finding.comparison_rule: Never mix v2602 native-runtime latency/resource measurements with v2607 quality/model-card results as though they describe one model identity.

counterhypothesis: The NeMo-Speech.cpp converter may already accept v2607 unchanged because the architecture remained sufficiently compatible; if so, the version fence remains necessary for identity but native compatibility can be promoted after exact conversion and load evidence.
falsifier: On the authorized clay-direct-dev runtime, pin v2607 exactly, convert with the pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp converter, verify consumed artifact/tokenizer identity, load successfully, and synthesize the fixed German corpus without fallback/network model APIs. Failure or incompatibility preserves v2602 as the native reference and routes v2607 to a separate runtime path.

variants: MagpieTTS v2602 via pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp native GGUF path
MagpieTTS v2607 via the same pinned converter/runtime only if conversion+load passes
measure: German CER/pronunciation on numbers, abbreviations, compounds and code-switching
post_hardware_benchmark_gate.text_normalization_note: Pin the text-normalization condition/version per arm, but leave detailed German TN dependency auditing to its separately claimed Trigger-7 lane.
